rationale.native-cpe: The exact reviewed native manifest uses rebuilt Tesseract 5.5.4 executables/libraries. The APK 5.5.2 identity applies only to retained read-only tessdata configs/fonts. This byte pin must be reviewed when the native payload changes. CVE-2026-4738 targets OSGeo GDAL before3.11.0, frmts/zlib/contrib/infback9/inftree9.c (CNA https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-4738). The shipped standard zlib1.3.2-r1 shared library does not compile this optional contrib decoder; GDAL and infback9 are absent from the exact pinned native manifest. Locked Alpine recipe0afa2da0e8c8051c6f8f64a7a388e5a259904245/main/zlib/APKBUILD (SHA256 c9348892bf3857602fe74fcc1d411e263b408b7d70344170396f5993a62bbe26) runs the standard configure/make shared target. Locked upstream source bb329a0a2cd0274d05519d61c667c062e06990d72e125ee2dfa8de64f0119d16 has normal OBJZ/PIC_OBJZ objects without infback9; its infback9 Makefile references are clean rules only. Actual official0a84bd3 libz.so.1.3.2 SHA256 ecc8b9dfc45eb7fa29b410ffaca6257873890de53b80fe91735737b49067c5f2 exports normal inflateBack but no inflateBack9. Review applies only to this exact ID/severity/package/version and native byte pin; raw Critical findings and threshold failures remain visible. This is not general zlib/GDAL safety or formal release approval. Exact vulnerability tuples are unchanged; new source govulncheck and exact candidate native assembly remain required. 2026-11-10 native refresh: actual clean CI42755581699 built the full native payload and both images and passed actual-image OCR acceptance.
